gist.headline: One more bee at the gate
gist.blurb: The contributor garden has a new keyholder. novastar dev can now get through the GitHub gate and into the workbench.
gist.summary: Added novastar dev to the GitHub ID allowlist used by the shared authentication layer, enabling their approved contributor access.
gist.impact: This gives novastar dev access to the authenticated contributor workflow without changing the public API or product experience.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a friendly gatekeeper at a cozy garden workshop entrance, welcoming a new small developer bee through a lime-green access gate; a retro terminal and flowering code-plants represent the shared GitHub authentication system.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gatekeeper cap, opening a lime green (#ecf874) garden-workshop gate for a small friendly developer bee carrying a code notebook. A glowing retro terminal, flowering code-plants, and warm cream, mint, and lavender scenery make the access gate feel welcoming; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
